summary: Shows mapping the imported certificate to a local account via New-Item on WSMan:\localhost\ClientCertificate, with Subject as the UPN, Issuer as the CA thumbprint, and the user's credential.
questions: How do I map a client certificate to a local Windows user for WinRM?
What goes in the Issuer field of a WinRM certificate mapping?

answer_card.title: Mapping the certificate to a local account
answer_card.answer_md:
```powershell
$credential = Get-Credential local-user
$cert = [System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509Certificate2]::new("cert.pem")
$chain = [System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509Chain]::new()
[void]$chain.Build($cert)
$caThumbprint = $chain.ChainElements.Certificate[-1].Thumbprint

New-Item -Path WSMan:\localhost\ClientCertificate -Subject $cert.GetNameInfo('UpnName', $false) -Issuer $caThumbprint -Credential $credential -Force
```

`Subject` = the cert's UPN, `Issuer` = the issuing CA's thumbprint, `Credential` = the local user's username/password.
